item.title: Review: Kitten by Stacey Yu
item.description: An adrift girl, her boyfriend's cat, and a premise that teased more depth than it delivered. 2.5/5 spines — ARC review, posted on publication day.

item.title: Review: The Correspondent by Virginia Evans
item.description: A life told entirely in letters. Quiet, tender, and a gentle nudge to truly correspond again. 4/5 spines.

item.title: Is Reading a Dying Art?
item.description: A love letter, an investigation, and the very first entry of this little blog — with polls so you can overrule me.
